label: Yadian 硅基半导体湿法清洗设备 product line
definition: Issuer product line 硅基半导体湿法清洗设备 for silicon-based wafer fabs. It contains BOTH batch (槽式) and single-wafer (单片式) cleaners — the issuer states the silicon line is divided into those two classes, batch mainly at 40 nm and above and single-wafer mainly below 40 nm — so the revenue, unit and price figures cannot be allocated between cleaning_batch and cleaning_single_wafer. Process coverage spans FEOL, BEOL, back-end packaging, wafer preparation and wafer reclaim; 8-inch and 12-inch.

label: Yadian 化合物半导体湿法清洗设备 product line
definition: Issuer product line 化合物半导体湿法清洗设备 for SiC, GaN and GaAs wafers at 6 inch and 8 inch. The issuer states the main tools in this line are MAINLY batch (主要为槽式湿法清洗设备) and every named tool in the compound product table is a bath tool, but the hedge 主要为 stops the revenue basket from being filed as cleaning_batch without over-claiming.

label: Yadian 光伏湿法设备 product line
definition: Issuer product line 光伏湿法设备 for photovoltaic cell manufacturing (TOPCon and BC routes): batch (槽式) and inline/chain (链式) texturing, polishing, etching and film-removal tools. Photovoltaic equipment, NOT semiconductor equipment; it is the largest single revenue line in 2025 H1.

label: Yadian 湿法清洗专用设备 subtotal
definition: Issuer subtotal 湿法清洗专用设备 = silicon-based + compound-semiconductor + photovoltaic wet equipment. Despite the label this subtotal INCLUDES photovoltaic wet-process equipment, so it is not a semiconductor-cleaning-only figure.

label: Yadian 配套产品及服务 line
definition: Issuer residual line 配套产品及服务: ancillary tools (wafer-carrier cleaners, furnace-tube cleaners), spare parts, repair and upgrade services, and, in FY2022 only, fab facility engineering work which the issuer exited from 2023.

label: Yadian 主营业务 total
definition: Issuer main-business total; smaller than total operating revenue, which also contains 其他业务收入.

label: Yadian consolidated company
definition: Company-wide consolidated figures from the prospectus summary financial table and the employee and intellectual-property sections.

label: Yadian 去氮化物设备 (hot-phosphoric batch cleaner)
definition: Named 去氮化物设备 / 高温磷酸设备, a BATCH-ONLY (槽式) tool in the issuer's silicon-based product table, 8-inch and 12-inch, using hot phosphoric acid to strip nitride. The issuer claims first domestic volume production of an 8-inch hot-phosphoric batch wet cleaner.

label: Yadian 有机清洗设备 (compound-semiconductor batch cleaner)
definition: Named 有机清洗设备 in the issuer's compound-semiconductor table: a bath tool with stainless-steel body, agitation and megasonic units and an automatic dispatch function, for post-metallisation resist strip on SiC, GaAs and GaN wafers at 6 inch and 8 inch.

label: Yadian RCA 清洗设备 (silicon line)
definition: Named RCA 清洗设备 in the issuer's silicon-based product table, available in BOTH batch and single-wafer configurations at 8 inch and 12 inch, using SC1/SC2/DHF chemistry for FEOL.

label: Yadian 去金属设备 (silicon line)
definition: Named 去金属设备 in the issuer's silicon-based product table, available in BOTH batch and single-wafer configurations at 8 inch and 12 inch, for Al/Cu/Ti/Pt/Ni removal and monitor-wafer reclaim.

label: Yadian TOPCon 电池槽式湿法设备
definition: Named TOPCon cell batch wet tool for texturing, alkaline polishing and de-wraparound-plating steps. Photovoltaic equipment; throughput is stated in silicon cells per hour, not wafers.

label: Yadian BC 电池槽式湿法设备
definition: Named BC (back-contact) cell batch wet tool with a redesigned bath, benchmarked by the issuer against a market-common six-basket tool. Photovoltaic equipment.

label: Yadian R&D personnel
definition: Issuer R&D headcount and share of total employees; the STAR-Market attribute table states the share as of 2024-12-31 while the employee table gives the 2025-06-30 headcount.

label: Yadian granted patents total
definition: Issuer count of granted patents as of 2025-06-30.

label: Yadian invention patents
definition: Issuer count of granted invention patents as of 2025-06-30, split domestic and overseas.

label: Yadian software copyrights
definition: Issuer count of registered software copyrights as of 2025-06-30.
